baseline.source: Batch640 pre-mutation permanent health run at the authoritative Batch639 parent; exact JSON retained in milestone evidence.

haya_doctor.missing_type_cause: Parent pointer referenced an unavailable revision; the available extracted-contract revision supplies the types and BoardPrep now falls through to it when host classes are absent.

patterns.family: missing study/source links and broken references
milestone additions and exact batch deltas

STRUCTURED_CONTENT.description: Canonical structured-content schema and active study metadata.
STRUCTURED_CONTENT.fix_guidance: Repair the content block through the canonical producer contract.

FLASHCARD_DERIVABILITY.description: Production-equivalent flashcard derivation for eligible questions.
FLASHCARD_DERIVABILITY.fix_guidance: Repair derivation inputs or the production card contract.

FLASHCARD_EXCLUSIONS.fix_guidance: Add complete evidence or derive the card; never hide a defect as an exclusion.

CARD_KEYS.description: Stable and unique derived card identities.
CARD_KEYS.fix_guidance: Repair the card identity inputs and source chain.

QUESTION_COUNTS.description: Canonical, effective-declared, and runtime board counts.
QUESTION_COUNTS.fix_guidance: Repair the production selection or eligibility mapping.

TRACEABILITY.fix_guidance: Repair the study link and linked source chain.

TAXONOMY.description: Taxonomy identifiers, hierarchy, and structural references.
TAXONOMY.fix_guidance: Repair the taxonomy path using existing taxonomy records.

ELIGIBILITY.fix_guidance: Repair eligibility records or the production index.

DEPTH_COVERAGE.description: Depth and coverage metadata, including explicit unknown values.
DEPTH_COVERAGE.fix_guidance: Review unknown metadata without inferring semantic correctness.

SOURCE_STUDY.description: Source and study record linkage and deterministic references.
SOURCE_STUDY.fix_guidance: Repair the source/study record or its internal link.

CALCULATION_METADATA.description: Calculation metadata contract and deterministic contradictions.
CALCULATION_METADATA.fix_guidance: Persist the canonical calculation payload or correct the calculation flag.

VERSION_CURRENTNESS.description: Deterministic currentness debt and review-status metadata.
VERSION_CURRENTNESS.fix_guidance: Review currentness against the applicable authority and effective period.

BALANCE_DIVERSITY.description: Active leaf balance, documented area deltas, and cheap concentration signals.
BALANCE_DIVERSITY.fix_guidance: Use the signal for planning; do not rewrite valid content solely to rebalance.

REPOSITORY_HEALTH_FOUNDATION.description: Canonical machine-readable health facade, catalog, and action queue.
REPOSITORY_HEALTH_FOUNDATION.fix_guidance: Keep the single RepositoryHealthEngine entrypoint available to CLI, CI, and UI.

developer_health_center.authorization: non-production developer route plus CSRF-protected POST Doctor refresh

performance.profile_note: One practical deterministic profile; no separate deep semantic all-pairs scan.
optimizations: host Doctor snapshot excludes external, batch, and test trees
cyclomatic analyzer indexes each file once

portfolio_decision.rationale: Fresh permanent health shows Criminologist is granular but thin (37 active leaves, 4 zero, 19 under10, median 9, high repeat risk); Mechanical Engineering and Psychometrician carry taxonomy-granularity REVIEW signals, while Architecture has lower thin-leaf urgency. Resolve deterministic health before expansion.

raw_storage_mutation_paths: historical batch writers and maintenance scripts
authoring_boundary.validation_bypass_risk: Historical calculation writers bypassed QuestionService and dropped payload metadata.
authoring_boundary.hardening: QuestionValidationService now enforces CalculationMetadataContract; Repository Health remains the repository-wide safety net.

root_cause.primary: Batch622/624/627 raw authoring helpers persisted calculation_required and quantitative flags without the calculation payload/family.
root_cause.validator: QuestionValidationService before Batch640 did not enforce the calculation contract
root_cause.consumer: RepositoryHealthEngine calculation check and production flashcard derivation
root_cause.recurrence_boundary_fixed: CalculationMetadataContract shared by write-time validation and Repository Health
